name: com.usebrainchain/brainchain
title: BrainChain
description: Hire frontier models through Jev, paying USDC on Base or USDG on Robinhood Chain for accepted work.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_PAYER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of the wallet that pays for tasks (0x followed by 64 hex characters). Use a dedicated wallet.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: mainnet or testnet. Testnet pays with test tokens that have no value.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_PAY_ON
environmentVariables.description: robinhood pays in USDG on Robinhood Chain after a one-time Permit2 approval; base pays in USDC on Base (Base Sepolia on testnet) with a signature alone.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_MAX_PRICE_UNITS
environmentVariables.description: The most the server pays for one task, in the payment token's base units (6 decimals).

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_BUDGET_UNITS
environmentVariables.description: The most the server pays in total while it runs, in the payment token's base units (6 decimals).
